_comment: Lines for who you were before the fall (flag origin_<id>) and for a run that remembers an earlier ending (flag echo, echo_<ending>).

lines.text: A hauler! I knew it. You walk like you're pulling something. Sit down. You're not pulling anything in here.
Hesper says you came down with seeds in your pockets like a squirrel. I said that's lovely. She said squirrels are a pest. We disagree about squirrels.
A medic! Thank goodness. My knee does a thing. No, the other knee. No. It's stopped now. It knew.
No family up there? Well. You've got a lot of nosy people down here now. Sorry. It comes with the soup.
I keep setting a place at the quiet table. For someone who's coming. Don't ask me who. I don't know who.
